Name: Ajwain Kharasan (Black Caraway)
Short description: A strong, bitter variety of Ajwain known for its darker color and potent medicinal effects on the digestive system.
Description:
Overview: Bunium persicum (Persian Cumin) features longer, thinner, and darker seeds compared to the common variety.

Key Actions: Used to reduce phlegm, treat severe stomach pain, and improve appetite.

Temperament: Warm and Dry.

Origin: Thrives in the dry, cool climates of Khorasan (Iran), Afghanistan, and Northern Pakistan.

Name: Akas Bail (Dodder)
Short description: A unique parasitic vine used in traditional medicine to purify the blood and treat neurological conditions.
Description:
Overview: Cuscuta reflexa (Amarbel) is a rootless vine that draws nutrients from host plants.

Medical Benefits: It is highly valued for strengthening the brain and nervous system, helping with anxiety, stress, and chronic skin diseases.

Action: Acts as a natural blood purifier and aids in the expulsion of excess black bile and phlegm.

Usage: Commonly consumed as a decoction (Joshanda).

Name: Amba Haldi (Mango Ginger)
Short description: A unique variety of turmeric that looks like ginger but carries the fresh, tropical aroma of raw mangoes.
Description:
Overview: Curcuma amada is a potent anti-inflammatory herb used for both internal health and external skin treatments.

Health Benefits: It strengthens the stomach and liver, aids digestion, and helps in clearing toxins from the blood.

External Use: Often applied as a paste to heal wounds and reduce joint pain and swelling.

Origin: Southeast Asia, including India and Sri Lanka.

Name: Andarjo Sheerin (Sweet Aloe Resin)
Short description: A natural dried resin derived from the Aloe plant, used as a mild laxative and liver stimulant.
Description:
Overview: Also known as Sabr, this reddish-brown resin is slightly sweet compared to the "Talkh" variety.

Medicinal Actions: It stimulates the liver, cleanses the intestines, and acts as a potent treatment for intestinal worms.

Usage: Effective for treating chronic constipation and expelling harmful humors from the body.

Origin: Arabia, Yemen, and Africa.

Name: Andarjo Talkh (Bitter Aloes)
Short description: An extremely bitter, dark resin used as a powerful internal cleanser for severe digestive stagnation.
Description:
• Overview: A highly concentrated form of Aloe resin that leaves a long-lasting bitter taste on the tongue.

  • Key Benefits: Acts as a strong purgative to clear severe constipation, stimulate the spleen and liver, and eliminate stubborn intestinal parasites.

  • Warning: Due to its high potency, it should be used in very small doses and is strictly avoided during pregnancy.

  • Origin: Africa (Somalia) and Yemen.

Name: Aqaqia (Acacia)
Short description: An aromatic herbal extract derived from the Acacia tree, traditionally used for digestive health and respiratory support.
Description:
Scientific Name: Acacia nilotica.

Health Benefits: Known for its ability to improve digestion, relieve constipation, and protect the liver and stomach lining.

Respiratory Support: Highly effective in managing respiratory issues and strengthening the immune system.

Usage: The gum or resin can be taken with milk or water, or applied as a paste for skin conditions.

Name: Ararot (Arrowroot)
Short description: A light, easily digestible natural starch obtained from rhizomes, ideal for cooling the body and soothing the stomach.
Description:
Scientific Name: Maranta arundinacea.

Digestive Strength: Traditionally used to treat diarrhea and dysentery while providing essential nourishment during recovery from illness.

Cooling Properties: Provides a calming effect on the intestines and helps combat dehydration and heat exhaustion.

Usage: Commonly mixed into soups, milk, or water as a thickening agent or nutritional supplement.

Name: Asaroon (Wild Ginger)
Short description: A potent aromatic root used in traditional medicine as a brain and nerve tonic.
Description:
Scientific Name: Asarum europaeum.

Cognitive Benefits: Acts as a powerful brain tonic that enhances memory and helps treat headaches and phlegmatic disorders.

Nerve Support: Traditionally used as a supportive therapy for nervous weakness and respiratory congestion.

Usage: Administered in powder or decoction form, often as an ingredient in complex herbal formulations

Name: Asgand Nagori (Indian Spikenard)
Short description: A premium aromatic herb valued for its ability to calm the mind, improve sleep quality, and relieve body pain.
Description:
Key Benefits: Specifically targeted toward nervous system disorders, joint pain, and physical fatigue.

Digestive Aid: Helps in relieving constipation and improving overall metabolic health.

Usage: The dried root is typically powdered and taken with milk or warm water, particularly in the evening for better rest.

Name: Ashok Bark (Ashoka)
Short description: A legendary herbal bark used for centuries to support female reproductive health and regulate natural cycles.
Description:
Scientific Name: Saraca asoca.

Women’s Wellness: Famous for regulating menstrual cycles, purifying the blood, and supporting uterine health.

Healing Properties: Also used to improve digestion and promote the healing of internal and external wounds.

Usage: Consumed as a powder with water or milk, or used topically as a healing paste.

Name: Babchi (Psoralea Seeds)
Short description: A powerful medicinal seed widely used for treating skin disorders like vitiligo and enhancing physical vitality.
Description:
Scientific Name: Psoralea corylifolia.

Skin Health: Highly valued for treating white patches (vitiligo) and improving overall skin texture and immunity.

Vitality: Traditionally used to boost sexual health, energy levels, and reduce body inflammation.

Usage: Can be used as a powder, decoction, or processed into oil for topical application.

Name: Balchar (Muskroot)
Short description: An aromatic root known for generating internal warmth and supporting the liver and respiratory system.
Description:
Scientific Name: Saussurea lappa.

Therapeutic Actions: Strengthens the stomach and liver, improves digestion, and provides relief from joint and muscle pain.

Hair Care: Often infused in oils to promote hair growth and scalp health.

Usage: Taken as a powder or decoction for internal health or mixed with oils for external massage.

Name: Black Cardamom (Bari Ilaichi)
Short description: Large, smoky-flavored cardamom pods that serve as both a gourmet spice and a remedy for heart and lung health
Description:
• Key Uses: Excellent for relieving stomach gas, colic, and improving heart strength.

  • Respiratory Relief: Helps clear phlegm and provides relief from coughs and common colds.

  • Culinary Value: Adds deep, smoky aroma to savory dishes like curries, lentils, and meat preparations.

Name: Behi Dana (Quince Seeds)
Short description: Natural seeds that form a soothing gel when soaked, used to treat dry coughs and stomach acidity.
Description:
Scientific Name: Cydonia oblonga.

Soothing Effect: The mucilage released by the seeds coats the throat and chest, relieving irritation and hoarseness.

Cooling Action: Highly effective for reducing heartburn, stomach burning, and urinary irritation.

Usage: Seeds should be soaked in water; only the resulting gel (mucilage) should be consumed.

Name: Isabgol Bhusi (Psyllium Husk - Indian)
Short description: A premium source of soluble fiber that effectively manages constipation, acidity, and cholesterol levels.
Description:
Scientific Name: Plantago ovata.

Digestive Regularity: Forms a gel-like substance that cleanses the intestines and promotes regular bowel movements.

Heart Health: Regularly consumed to help lower cholesterol and maintain overall cardiovascular health.

Usage: Mix with a full glass of water or milk. It is essential to drink plenty of fluids when using this product.

Name: Isabgol Bhusi (Psyllium Husk - Pakistan)
Short description: A locally sourced, high-purity soluble fiber used as a gentle remedy for constipation and intestinal health.
Description:
Scientific Name: Plantago ovata.

Health Benefits: Effectively relieves constipation, reduces stomach acidity, and aids in lowering cholesterol levels.

Mechanism: When mixed with water, it forms a gel-like substance that cleanses the intestines and promotes regularity.

Usage: Mix 5–10 grams with water or milk. It is essential to drink plenty of water throughout the day for the fiber to work effectively.

Name: Barada Sheesham (Indian Rosewood Sawdust)
Short description: Finely processed wood powder from the Sheesham tree, primarily used for its skin-healing and anti-inflammatory properties.
Description:
Scientific Name: Dalbergia sissoo.

External Benefits: Highly effective for wound healing, reducing skin inflammation, and treating boils or itching.

Joint Care: Often mixed with oils for massage to provide relief from joint and muscle pain.

Usage: Applied topically as a paste or powder. Internal use is rare and should only be done under expert supervision.

Name: Barg-e-Banafsha (Violet Leaves)
Short description: Nutrient-rich leaves of the violet plant, traditionally used to treat coughs, fever, and blood-related disorders.
Description:
Scientific Name: Viola odorata.

Key Uses: Widely used to treat respiratory congestion, dry coughs, and common colds.

Therapeutic Actions: Acts as a blood purifier and supports healthy liver and stomach functions.

Usage: Usually consumed as a herbal tea or decoction.

Name: Barg-e-Beri (Mulberry Leaves)
Short description: High-quality mulberry leaves valued for their ability to regulate blood sugar levels and boost the immune system.
Description:
Scientific Name: Morus alba.

Metabolic Health: Frequently used by diabetic patients to help maintain healthy glucose levels.

Digestive Aid: Helps relieve constipation and serves as a natural blood purifier.

Usage: Can be taken as a powder or brewed into a health-promoting tea.

Name: Barg-e-Gaozaban (Borage Leaves)
Short description: A calming herbal leaf known for its ability to strengthen the heart and soothe the nervous system during times of stress.
Description:
• Scientific Name: Borago officinalis.

  • Emotional Well-being: Traditionally used to alleviate anxiety, restlessness, and low mood (exhilarant).

  • Physical Benefits: Helps reduce fever and acts as a natural blood purifier.

  • Usage: Taken as a decoction or tea; not recommended for use during pregnancy.

Name: Barg-e-Henna (Henna Leaves)
Short description: Natural aromatic leaves used for their cooling effect, wound-healing properties, and as a traditional hair conditioner.
Description:
Scientific Name: Lawsonia inermis.

Hair Benefits: Strengthens hair roots, adds natural shine, and treats scalp itching.

Skin Support: Used topically to soothe minor wounds, skin allergies, and inflammation.

Usage: The dried powder is made into a paste for external application on the hair or skin.

Name: Barg-e-Ma’safar (Safflower Leaves)
Short description: Potent herbal leaves used to detoxify the body, purify the blood, and manage joint-related inflammation.
Description:
Scientific Name: Carthamus tinctorius.

Therapeutic Actions: Excellent for improving blood circulation, reducing swelling, and treating chronic skin disorders.

Body Cleansing: Helps in the effective expulsion of waste materials from the body.

Usage: Administered as a powder or decoction; avoid use during pregnancy.

Name: Barg-e-Qinnab (Cannabis Leaves)
Short description: Potent medicinal leaves used in highly controlled doses for severe pain relief and as a sedative for nervous tension.
Description: Scientific Name: Cannabis sativa. Medical Use: Traditionally applied to treat chronic headaches, insomnia, and joint inflammation. Nerve Support: Acts as a powerful relaxant for the nervous system. Safety Note: This is a potent herb. It must be used in very small, controlled quantities and only under professional guidance.

Name: Barg-e-Shahtra (Fumitory Leaves)
Short description: A premier herb for skin health, known for its ability to clear acne and support liver detoxification.
Description:
Scientific Name: Fumaria officinalis.

Skin Health: The primary choice for treating acne, boils, rashes, and persistent itching.

Internal Balance: Regulates bile production and reduces internal body heat and inflammation.

Usage: Commonly taken as a distillate (Arq), decoction, or powder.

Name: Barg-e-Snobr (Pine Needles)
Short description: Fragrant needles from the pine tree used for respiratory relief and as a natural blood purifier.
Description:
Scientific Name: Pinus species.

Respiratory Relief: Effective in reducing cough, cold, and chest congestion.

Healing Actions: Provides relief from fever and helps soothe digestive and skin inflammations.

Usage: Typically used in steam inhalations, teas, or concentrated decoctions.

Name: Green Cardamom (Ilaichi Choti)
Short description: A small, vibrant green cardamom pod known for its intense aroma and refreshing taste, used widely in both culinary and medicinal applications.
Description:
Overview: Known as the "Queen of Spices," Green Cardamom is a tiny pod packed with flavorful seeds that provide a sweet and pungent profile.

Health Benefits: Traditionally used to improve digestion, relieve stomach gas (colic), and freshen breath by reducing oral bacteria.

Culinary Use: A staple ingredient in teas, desserts, and savory curries to enhance fragrance and depth.

Origin: Primarily grown in India, Sri Lanka, and Indonesia.

Name: Nervine Tonic / Aromatic Resin
Short description: A premium aromatic herb and resin used for centuries to soothe the mind, improve sleep, and support respiratory health.
Description:
Overview: Often referred to as "The Broom of the Brain," this herb is highly valued for its ability to "sweep away" mental fatigue and congestion.

Mental Wellness: Promotes deep relaxation, reduces anxiety, and is an excellent natural remedy for insomnia.

Physical Benefits: Useful for managing fevers, healing wounds, and protecting liver and stomach health.

Usage: Can be taken as a powder or used as incense for its calming therapeutic fragrance.

Name: Calendula (Nakhoona)
Short description: Bright orange and yellow flowers renowned for their natural antiseptic properties and ability to purify the blood and skin.
Description:
Overview: Calendula officinalis is a powerhouse of nutrients like Vitamin A, C, and E, making it a "skin specialist" in traditional medicine.

Skin & Liver Health: Effectively treats acne, itching, and rashes while supporting liver detoxification and improving digestion.

Healing Actions: Its natural oil softens skin and promotes faster wound healing. It also helps relieve eye inflammation.

Usage: Commonly consumed as a herbal tea or applied topically as an oil or paste.

Name: Camel Katara (Ont Katara)
Short description: A resilient desert herb used specifically to treat stubborn digestive issues and respiratory discomforts.
Description:
Overview: Found in arid regions, the roots and leaves of this plant are potent remedies for internal heat and stagnation.

Digestive Relief: Excellent for removing stomach gas, treating bloating, and relieving stomach pain.

Respiratory Aid: Traditionally used to manage symptoms of common colds and coughs.

Origin: Naturally sourced from the dry regions of Balochistan and Sindh.

Name: Whole Psyllium (Sabut Ispaghol)
Short description: Whole seeds of the Psyllium plant that provide a natural, gel-like fiber to support smooth bowel movements and heart health.
Description:
Overview: Unlike the husk, these are the whole seeds which swell significantly in water to soften the intestinal tract.

Key Benefits: Acts as a natural laxative to relieve constipation, aids in weight management, and helps control blood sugar levels.

Heart Health: Regularly used to lower cholesterol and improve cardiovascular function.

Usage: Soak 1–2 tablespoons in water or milk. Ensure high water intake throughout the day for best results.

Name: Snake Root (Asrol)
Short description: A potent root valued for its scientifically recognized ability to lower blood pressure and calm the nervous system.
Description:
Overview: Also known as Sarpagandha, it is one of the most important herbs for managing hypertension and mental stress.

Therapeutic Actions: Helps lower high blood pressure (hypotensive), promotes sound sleep, and strengthens the overall nervous system.

Mental Calmness: Traditionally used to treat restlessness and promote mental relaxation.

Safety Note: Must be used in controlled doses; consult a specialist for blood pressure management.

Name: Aftimoon (Dodder)
Short description: A specialized parasitic vine used to clear mental heaviness, purify the blood, and treat chronic skin conditions.
Description:
Overview: Known as Cuscuta reflexa, this herb is a staple in Unani medicine for addressing "melancholic" (black bile) disorders.

Neurological Benefits: Improves brain function and is used for mental stress, anxiety, and relieving the feeling of mental burden.

Detoxification: Acts as a strong blood purifier and is effective against chronic constipation and persistent skin rashes.

Usage: Typically consumed as a decoction (joshanda) for internal body cleansing.
